newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins firm further, await debt deal.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins firm further, await debt deal.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds rose on continuing demand in Russia and abroad, with the market awaiting further positive news on restructuring of Russia's commercial bank debt, dealers said.

"Notable buying interest has been seen on the market since yesterday," an ICFI Moscow Partners Bank dealer said. He added the upward move could be due to a long awaited restructuring of Russia's external debt.
Emerging debt market dealers said earlier that Russian Vnesh loans firmed on expectations of further positive news between Russia and the London Club following meetings in Frankfurt on Tuesday.

"Volumes traded are high; non-residents are active today as well," National Reserve Bank dealer Andrei Ivanov-Golitsyn said. "Prices were moving either way as banks were taking profits and buying for their clients."
Dealers said a further rise was likely this week, tempered by short-term corrections. But a longer trend would depend on U.S. May unemployment and payroll data due on Friday.
